recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. If the work group later wants to actually relax the eld-20 regex or make it conditional by StructureDefinition kind, that should be handled as a new decision rather than as additional FHIR-38796 work.
issue_request: FHIR-38796 was a Published FHIR-core change request resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to relax eld-20 for logical models by allowing uppercase starting characters inside paths or by excluding logical models from the warning; the final resolution instead appended: "Logical models may be less concerned about this implication."
initial_application: Historical commit 1f7c098e13467d400b0750093ac474999e13dcd2 applied FHIR-38796 by appending the approved logical-model sentence to the eld-20 warning text in source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml.
additional_context: Sibling FHIR-38795 clarified the eld-19 and eld-20 descriptions from the same Zulip thread. FHIR-I minutes for 2022-12-12 approved FHIR-38795 and FHIR-38796 as Persuasive with Modification, motion Grahame Grieve/Gino Canessa 13-0-0. The current source keeps eld-20 as a warning and preserves the regex, matching the narrowed Jira resolution rather than the broader initial request to fully relax the expression.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml already includes the exact logical-model caveat approved for FHIR-38796, and source/fhir.ini shows ElementDefinition is in the current build.
